item.title: AI & Java: from prompts to real software — memory, tools, JSON, and Quarkus
item.description:
Inspired by the vJUG CONNECT talk “AI & Java: From Structured Prompts to Smarter Apps” (YouTube).

TL;DR #

If you take away one thing: prompt engineering isn’t the point. The point is context engineering and the contract between your code and the model:

  • memory (short/long term, consistency, conflicts),
  • tools (functions the LLM can call),
  • structured outputs (JSON/records/enums instead of free text),
  • observability + timeouts + fallbacks (because “works in a demo” means nothing in prod).

The talk is blunt: this isn’t magic — it’s software.

item.title: Spring Boot + Kotlin : NoClassDefFoundError: jakarta/servlet/Filter (root cause + fix)
item.description:
TL;DR (fix it in 60 seconds) #

If you see:

  • ** WARNING ** : Your ApplicationContext is unlikely to start due to a @ComponentScan of the default package.
  • then NoClassDefFoundError: jakarta/servlet/Filter

➡️ Verdict: your @SpringBootApplication class is in the default package (no package ...).
➡️ Fix: declare a real root package + move the file into the matching folder (and align your tests).
